description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

signal_window.description: Pre-market window during which signals may be issued (GMT). Routine fires at 06:00 GMT; window closes at 08:30 GMT.

risk.description: Non-negotiable risk caps applied to every signal.

confluence.description: Scoring thresholds. HIGH fires at >=5, MEDIUM at 4, WAIT at <=3.

macro_kill_switches.description: Any of these fires → post kill-switch message and stop. No ticker analysis.
